item.title: Augusta father’s McDonald’s arrest case ends with dismissal
item.description: Chris Louis, the Augusta father who gained national sympathy after claiming he left his children at a local McDonald’s to attend a job interview, has had all criminal charges against him dismissed, according to court records. The post Augusta father’s McDonald’s arrest case ends with dismissal appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta robbers targeted stores, skipped busy locations
item.description: Three men charged with robbing the Broad Street Family Dollar were looking for businesses to hit but skipped others because they were too busy, authorities said. The post Augusta robbers targeted stores, skipped busy locations appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Eagles hang on to beat Bills 13-12 when Josh Allen misses an open Khalil Shakir on 2-point try
item.description: Josh Allen sailed a 2-point conversion attempt wide of open receiver Khalil Shakir in the back of the end zone with 5 seconds remaining, and the Philadelphia Eagles hung on for a 13-12 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday. The post Eagles hang on to beat Bills 13-12 when Josh Allen misses an open Khalil Shakir on 2-point try appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: A Martinez Republican arrested for pouring coffee on former Columbia County Commissioner Dewey Galeas during a political meeting in February has been sentenced. The post Coffee toss at GOP event leads to probation for Martinez woman appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: AGs say ‘As You Sow’ may violate antitrust laws with anti-fossil fuel alliance
item.description: A coalition of 18 attorneys general called on the nonprofit group As You Sow to end activities that may violate antitrust and consumer protection laws. The post AGs say ‘As You Sow’ may violate antitrust laws with anti-fossil fuel alliance appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Eric Kern named associate vice president for sponsored programs at Augusta University
item.description: Eric M. Kern has been named associate vice president for Sponsored Programs and executive director of the Augusta University Research Institute, the university announced. His appointment is effective Jan. 12, 2026. The post Eric Kern named associate vice president for sponsored programs at Augusta University appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: CSRA state parks to host First Day Hikes on New Year’s Day
item.description: Residents across the CSRA will have a chance to begin the new year outdoors as a few local state parks will host First Day Hikes on Thursday, Jan. 1. The post CSRA state parks to host First Day Hikes on New Year’s Day appeared first on The Augusta Press.
